# relay_cloud_integration (Data Source)

Reads a cloud integration, a customer cloud account Relay assumes a role into, by ID or by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_cloud_integration" "backups" {
  workspace_id = data.relay_workspace.prod.id
  name         = "backups"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace to look in.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `name` (String) Integration name. The API does not enforce unique names, so the lookup fails when more than one integration has it.

### Read-Only

- `aws_account_id` (String) AWS account the role belongs to.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider, `aws`.
- `external_id` (String) External ID Relay presents when assuming the role.
- `last_error` (String) Why the last role assumption failed, when it did.
- `role_arn` (String) ARN of the IAM role Relay assumes.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `connected` or `error`.
